segment.description: Out-of-park main-stem Little Pigeon River at Sevierville (USGS 03470000, gage elevation 878.91 ft, Sevier County) between the GSMNP boundary and Douglas Lake head. Reach discipline: the GSMNP prongs (Middle Prong, West Prong) are separate catalog waters documented as wild in another batch — park facts are NOT transferred here; TWRA's own Little Pigeon stocking rows are prong reaches ('Mid. Prong Little Pigeon River', 'W. Prong Little Pigeon R. (Pigeon Forge)'), not this main stem.
segment.boundaries: GSMNP boundary downstream through Pigeon Forge/Sevierville to the Douglas Reservoir backwater, Sevier County; gage 03470000 at Sevierville.

coldSource.notes: Free-flowing valley river at low elevation in a city corridor; no cold-water source documented in any source checked. USGS 03470000 (identity verified via waterservices expanded site output: 'LITTLE PIGEON RIVER AT SEVIERVILLE, TN') records only streamflow and gage height — no water-temperature parameter (July 2025 IV query returned zero temperature series).

holdover.detail: Nothing resolved for the Sevierville main stem. The catalog itself carries an owner-confirmed local-knowledge claim (September 2026) that TWRA stocks this reach, explicitly because the TWRA dataset does not list it; no agency document found confirms a main-stem stocking. TWRA's live trout page lists only prong entries for the Little Pigeon system, and the TWRA stocking dataset rows (repo snapshot) are Mid Prong (Feb-May and late Oct-Nov weeks, rainbow) and W Prong at Pigeon Forge (Jan-May and Oct weeks, rainbow) — different reaches.

wildPopulation.detail: No out-of-park main-stem wild-trout record resolved. Wild-fish claims for the prongs inside the park belong to separate catalog waters and are not transferable.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: No agency record resolves for this reach: TWRA's Little Pigeon program rows are the park/city prongs, no temperature data exists at the Sevierville gage, and the stocking claim rests on an owner local-knowledge note.

sourcesChecked: repo-local TWRA stocking schedule snapshot packages/content/data/twra-stocking-schedule.json (only 'Mid. Prong' and 'W. Prong (Pigeon Forge)' Little Pigeon rows; no Sevierville main-stem row)
